arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
# Treasury bond weekly average yields for 1970

# First period: First available week in February to last available week in April
first_feb = 6.71  # Feb 6
last_apr = 6.69   # Apr 24

# Second period: First available week in July to last available week in September
first_jul = 6.73  # July 3
last_sep = 6.52   # Sept 25

# Calculate percentage changes (as percentages, not decimals)
change1 = abs(last_apr - first_feb) / first_feb * 100
change2 = abs(last_sep - first_jul) / first_jul * 100

print(f"Change Feb 6 to Apr 24: |{last_apr} - {first_feb}| / {first_feb} * 100 = {abs(last_apr - first_feb) / first_feb * 100:.4f}%")
print(f"Change Jul 3 to Sept 25: |{last_sep} - {first_jul}| / {first_jul} * 100 = {abs(last_sep - first_jul) / first_jul * 100:.4f}%")

print(f"\nAbsolute percentage change 1: {change1:.4f}%")
print(f"Absolute percentage change 2: {change2:.4f}%")

# Calculate ratio
ratio = change1 / change2

print(f"\nRatio: {change1:.4f} / {change2:.4f} = {ratio:.4f}")
print(f"Rounded to one decimal place: {ratio:.1f}")
EOF
